RAJYA SABHA

List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the November 23, 2007/Agrahayana 2, 1929 (Saka)

(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs,
Food and Public Distribution; Health and Family Welfare;
Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises;
Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions  20
Import of wheat
*121. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of wheat imported from
foreign countries in the year 2006-07;
(b) the names of States from which
complaints have been received that wheat
imported from foreign countries is not fit
for consumption;
(c) whether Central Government has got
these complaints investigated and if so, the
details thereof; and
(d) whether it is a fact that the wheat
imported from foreign countries has not
been found fit for human consumption as
per the samples tested by Maharashtra
Government?
Irregularities in distribution of ration
in West Bengal
*122. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the attention
of Central Government has been drawn
towards the irregularities in the distribution
of ration in West Bengal;
(b) if so, the steps taken to check the
same; and
(c) if no steps have been taken, the
reasons therefor?
Conversion of railway stations as
world class
*123. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of  RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether there is a proposal under
active consideration of Government for
conversion of railway stations as world
class railway stations;
Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
39

40
(b) if so, the names of such stations,
zone-wise;
(c) whether Azamgarh railway station
in Uttar Pradesh is also included in the list
of world class railway stations; and
(d) if not, the main reasons for such a
discrimination with Azamgarh railway
station?
Blind population in the country
*124. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of  HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India has
become home to the world’s largest number
of blind people;
(b) if so, how many eye donation banks
are available in the country, particularly in
Maharashtra State and how many of them
donate eyes every year;
(c) how many optometrists pass out
every year and considering our population,
whether they are sufficient to fulfil patients,
requirements; and
(d) whether Government has set any
target to eliminate blindness or control of
blindness and if so, the details thereof?
Shortage of wheat
*125. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
 Will the Minister of  AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) what would be the expected shortfall
of wheat for the next three years; and
(b) what is the plan of Government to
meet the shortage?
Ayurvedic doctors engaged in research
work
*126. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of  HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELF ARE be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of Ayurvedic doctors and
others in the employment of Central
Government who are engaged in research
and for the promotion of the system,
category-wise and grade-wise;
(b) the Central budget for research and
promotion of Ayurveda and the actual
utilization thereof for the last three years
ending 31st March, 2007; and
(c) the sanctioned budget for the
purpose for the year 2007-08?
Contract farming
*127. SHRI SHARAD ANANTRAO
JOSHI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of cases of contract
farming in operation and cases of corporate
farming in Maharashtra; and
(b) what are the steps taken to set up a
strong system to monitor contracts, so as
to avoid exploitation of the workers/
growers/farmers?
Food riots against PDS agents in West
Bengal
*128. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of
food riots against PDS agents that took
place in certain districts of West Bengal;

41
(b) if so, the details of causes;
(c) whether Government has taken up
the issue with the State Government; and
(d) what steps are being taken to
discount such incidents by improving
efficacy of PDS?
Increasing the allocation to States for
BPL households
*129. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: W ill the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has increased
the allocation of food grain to States for
Below Poverty Line (BPL) households;
(b) if so, the details of such allocation
made to each State during the last three
years, especially for Andhra Pradesh;
(c) the expenditure incurred on food
subsidy during the last three years, State-
wise and especially in Andhra Pradesh; and
(d) the steps being taken to give food
subsidy in future, especially in Andhra

Total number of questions  94

Permission to supply genetically
modified seeds
530. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: W ill the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government has allowed multinational
companies to supply genetically modified
seeds to India;
(b) if so, the details of those
multinational companies; and
(c) what effects and ill-effects these
seeds are going to have on human beings,
animals and environment?
Potential for growth of floriculture
industry
531. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether India has vast potential for
growth of floriculture industry;
(b) whether Government has distributed
financial help to the States for expansion
of the area under flower cultivation;
(c) if so, the details thereof, inter-alia,
indicating the financial help that has been
given to the Orissa State under this head;
(d) whether Government also proposes
to set up Agri Export Zones for floriculture
besides a large number of flower clusters
under the National Horticulture Mission;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof, indicating
those that are proposed to be set up in
Orissa State?
Amount released under Market
Intervention Scheme
532. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) what are the details of the amount of
grant released to various States under the
Market Intervention Scheme during the last
two years;
(b) whether his Ministry is also
contemplating to increase the amount of
Central Government in aid upto seventy
five per cent to the States of Central
Himalayan zone like that of North-Eastern
States;
(c) if so, by when a decision would be
taken in this regard; and
Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

127
(d) if not, what are the details of the
alternative measures taken to give benefit
to the middle and small farmers of these
States?
Level of alkalinity in soil/fertile
land
533. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to
continuous and increased use of chemical
fertilizers, the level of alkalinity and
salinity in the soil/fertile land has gone up
high;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
the use of gypsum has been very useful in
bringing down salinity and alkalinity level;
and
(c) if so, the immediate efforts being
made by Government in this regard?
Policy on contract farming
534. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is actively
considering to frame a policy on contract
farming with a view to co-ordinate
production and marketing activities;
(b) if so, the details thereof and when it
is expected to be initiated; and
(c) how far this shall be helpful to the
small farmers for better remuneration of
their produce particularly in backward
areas/districts of Uttar Pradesh?
Rain based cultivation
535. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the percentage of area of cultivation
based on rain water in the country and State-
wise details of cultivation based on rain
water;
(b) whether any action plan has been
formulated by his Ministry to double the
production capacity of cultivation based
on rain water; and
(c) if so, the details of assistance being
provided to the States to execute this action
plan by the end of this Five Year Plan?
Systems to help improving food
production
536. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) how the Geographic Information
System, Remote Sensing, Global Position
System, Simulation Modeling are helping
in increasing the food production in the
country;
(b) whether it is a fact that BARC has
developed 29 improved varieties for
commercial cultivation;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) how his Ministry is planning to go
ahead in application of biosensors,
biotechnology, nano-technology, etc., for
improving the production of foodgrains in
the country?
Suicides by farmers
537. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the cases of suicide by
farmers are increasing rapidly in various
parts of the country despite the
rehabilitation packages;
Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

128
(b) if so, the number of such cases
reported during the last three years and
this year, so far, State-wise;
(c) whether Government has identified
the reasons for the same; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
corrective steps taken by Government to
remedy the situation?
